items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: Duke just pointed to me and told me to come over and sit down.

ctx.x: You know, in the beginning he just happened to look around the room and there his doctor and we -- we were having drinks together, and Duke just pointed to me and told me to come over and sit down. Now, I didn't know that the red light was on, and Irving Townsend was the producer in the booth at that point, you know, and he started -- Duke counted off and started -- oh, what's the -- "Hello, Little Girl," I guess. Jimmy Rushing sang it.
